themes.title: User Identification and Selection
themes.description: The system allows users to search for and confirm the identity of other users using a unique Medical ID (MID). It ensures accurate user selection and provides error handling for invalid IDs.

themes.title: Dynamic User Interaction Frame
themes.description: A feature that provides a movable frame within a web page to display additional user-related content or features dynamically, enhancing user interaction without disrupting the main workflow.

themes.title: Password Reset Process
themes.description: The system facilitates password reset by verifying user identity through MID and role, followed by answering a security question. It ensures secure password management and provides error handling for incorrect inputs.

themes.title: Fake Email Archive for Testing
themes.description: A tool for viewing and verifying fake emails sent from the system, including details like recipients, sender, subject, and content, to ensure email functionality accuracy during testing.

themes.title: Transaction Log for System Evaluation
themes.description: A logging tool that records all system transactions with details such as date, transaction ID, type, and user IDs involved, aiding in troubleshooting, auditing, and testing system operations.
